title: Cloud-run runbook says forge access waits on dm6, but the App rung shipped
body:
Precondition 3 of the runbook says the factory cannot push or open PRs for this repository 'until the GitHub App rung lands (epic dm6)'. The App rung shipped in #115 and #116 (cloudflare/src/github-app.ts, the manifest flow, per-run installation tokens). Only lej, the upstream credential-ownership contract re-cut, keeps dm6 open. An operator reading the runbook would wrongly believe a cloud run of this repository is impossible, or point the run at a scratch repo. The precondition should read: `ticfac factory status` (or doctor) names the App rung live and installed on this repository.
evidence: docs/pi-durable-cloud-run-runbook.md:41-45; git log origin/main --grep dm6 (b45e0f8f5, 6a09b7a8b)
